scope: Repair diagnostics, shared validation workspace scheduling and approved remaining-task revisions
sourceState: Uncommitted working tree; source fingerprints below
regressions: Real missing ESM export, no-change repair, exact diagnostic forwarded to successful retry
Recovery of legacy erased diagnostics restricted to latest validation and same candidate; no proofs restored
Build/check/e2e commands cannot overwrite shared generated artifacts, including legacy gates without readOnly
Explicit read-only gates retain bounded concurrency and named resource exclusion
CLI plan proposal and hash approval preserve completed commit, task history, declared costs and obligations
Revised execution survives a controller restart; completed task is not replayed; final gates and independent fixture QA pass
Completed-task changes, removed gates, lower lanes, changed criteria, cyclic dependencies, wrong hashes, leases and stale proposals are refused
limits: Offline deterministic workers do not measure model quality or real feature latency
Remaining-plan revision preserves task IDs and criterion mappings; splitting, merging and deleting tasks is not supported
readOnly is an operator assertion about workspace writes, not a filesystem sandbox
